caseName: Local Union 429, International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers v. Farnsworth & Chambers Co.
caseNameFull: Local Union 429, International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, A. F. of L. v. Farnsworth & Chambers Co., Inc.
attorneys: Cecil D. Branstetter for petitioners. Cecil Sims for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment of the Supreme Court of Tennessee is reversed. Weber v. Anheuser-Busch, Inc., 348 U. S. 468; Garner v. Teamsters Union, 346 U. S. 485.
